command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_thermal.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Physical power q=b+0.6*cos(omega*t)-0.8*sin(omega*t) W at omega=1.75 rad/s. Independently integrate max(q,0) and max(-q,0) over the period using adaptive quadrature split at analytical zeros. Seven DC biases spanning both signs and the tangency thresholds, swapped pair order and a quarter-cycle phase rotation. Additional test uses the near-tangent asymptotic 4*sqrt(2)/3*gap^(3/2) J at omega=1, gap=2^-50, and a static-only load.
